intro: Deciding where to live? Here's the East vs West rundown, the way a Tech student would put it. Opinions are labeled with who said them; the official stuff is tagged too.

verdict.label: Our read of the sources below
verdict.east: You want to be in the middle of everything: Freshman Hill, the stadium, lots of freshmen, and short walks to engineering and computing classes. You don't mind older, smaller rooms.
verdict.west: You want it quieter and more relaxed, with bigger, more recently renovated rooms and the gym (CRC) close by. You don't mind a longer walk or a bus to some classes.

rows.west: Slightly more chill, quieter and more relaxed.
rows.east: The heart of the action: most freshman dorms, Bobby Dodd and Freshman Hill.

rows.west: About 15' x 11' for traditional rooms. Students say rooms are on average a bit larger.
rows.east: About 12' x 10' up to 15' x 11'. Students call the dorms older and smaller.
rows.by: GT Housing FAQ (sizes); Prked and Transfer Hub (opinions)

rows.west: Woodruff has suites, about 15' x 12' (renovated, per students).
rows.by: GT Housing FAQ and room page; hall locations from student sources

rows.west: A bit of a longer walk to some classes. Farther from CULC, say students. The bus is described as pretty solid.
rows.east: Many classes are close, especially engineering and computing.
rows.by: Prked student guide, 2025; GT Transfer Hub

rows.west: West Village Dining Commons, described as the newest hall.
rows.east: Brittain, praised for its omelet station. Tech Square restaurants are closer.
rows.by: Prked student guide, 2025; GT Transfer Hub

rows.west: Campus Recreation Center (CRC) is on the West side.
rows.east: Glenn and Towers share a connector with a fitness center, and Perry has a workout room.
rows.by: Prked student guide, 2025; GT Transfer Hub

rows.both: Both sides get the free campus buses (track them at bus.gatech.edu or the Transloc app), the Midnight Rambler late at night, and the Stingerette ride service from 8:00 p.m. to 3:15 a.m. (not on Institute holidays or home football games).
Laundry in the halls is free. You are not required to live on campus as a first-year. There are no hall tours, but 360 virtual tours are on the housing site.

halls.by: Prked student guide, 2025 (Harris placement: Technique ranking). Double-check on the housing map.

caveat: Prked is a parking company's blog, so treat it as one student-style opinion, not gospel. Talk to a current student too.
